meta.gross_estimate: gross range = net/0.85 .. net/0.7 (15–30% store fee); an estimate, not data

regions.world: World (sum of all countries in the export, up to 112)
regions.tier1: Tier-1 countries (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, DE, FR, NL, BE, AT, CH, LU, SE, NO, DK, FI, JP, KR, SG)

notes: One granularity per app+month (monthly > weekly > daily); never summed together.
Weekly data is assigned to the month containing the week's Thursday.
partial = month built from incomplete weekly/daily data.
